choice: dock.json.example holds the optional browser control with chrome:false; dock-setup.sh reuses a page pane seeded from it and adds the server tab.
context: A Dock browser tab created from the CLI shows cmux's toolbar and address bar.
rejected: Hiding the toolbar from the CLI (new-pane and new-surface have no such option); writing the user's global ~/.config/cmux/dock.json from the installer (personal config, and it seeds only a Dock without a saved layout).
title: A chromeless Dock page needs a browser control in dock.json
